description: This file defines the ViewUI class in the Drupal views_ui module, managing UI-related temporary settings and interactions for views, including form handling, caching, locking, and preview rendering.

classes.name: ViewUI
classes.description: Manages UI-related temporary settings and interactions for Drupal views, including form handling, caching, locking, and preview rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ViewUI object wrapping a ViewEntityInterface storage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value, either from storage or local property.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the view.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value, either in storage or locally.

methods.name: isSyncing
methods.description: Checks if the view is syncing.

methods.name: isUninstalling
methods.description: Checks if the view is uninstalling.

methods.name: standardSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, applying changes to default or current display.

methods.name: standardCancel
methods.description: Handles form cancel action, clearing cache and redirecting.

methods.name: getStandardButtons
methods.description: Provides standard Apply/Cancel/OK buttons for forms.

methods.name: getOverrideValues
methods.description: Determines override and revert states for display forms.

methods.name: addFormToStack
methods.description: Adds a form to the UI stack for multi-step forms.

methods.name: submitItemAdd
methods.description: Handles adding new items to a view.

methods.name: endQueryCapture
methods.description: Ends capturing database queries and stores them.

methods.name: renderPreview
methods.description: Renders a preview of the view with query and performance info.

methods.name: getFormProgress
methods.description: Returns current progress in multi-step form stack.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Caches the current view state in shared tempstore.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if the view is locked for editing.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates unknown method calls to the storage object.

methods.name: getDisplay
methods.description: Gets a display by ID from storage.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the view.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the view is new.

methods.name: bundle
methods.description: Returns the bundle of the entity.

methods.name: createDuplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the view.

methods.name: toUrl
methods.description: Returns URL object for the view.

methods.name: toLink
methods.description: Returns a link object for the view.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the view.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports the view as an array.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Returns the language of the view.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the status of the view.

methods.name: getExecutable
methods.description: Returns the executable object for the view.

methods.name: duplicateDisplayAsType
methods.description: Duplicates a display as a different type.

methods.name: hasLinkTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a link template exists.

methods.name: addDisplay
methods.description: Adds a display to the view.

methods.name: isInstallable
methods.description: Checks if the view is installable.

methods.name: hasTrustedData
methods.description: Checks if view has trusted data.
